utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon to everybody. This Status Conference is called to order. Madam Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is Case Number IT-95-14-A, The Prosecutor versus Tihomir Blaskic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. May I ask Mr. Blaskic if he understands the proceedings, if there is any problem with the interpretation. THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Good afternoon. Good afternoon, Your Honour. I understand everything, and I have no problem with the interpretation.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Blaskic. Now, may I call for appearances. Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. FARRELL
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. I'm Norman Farrell appearing for the Prosecution. With me is Ms. Kelly Howick, and our case manager, Ms. Lourdes Galicia. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. For the Defence. I understand there is a phone link like on other occasions.

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYMAN
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Appearing by phone from Los Angeles for the appellant are Russell Hayman and Andrew Paley, and appearing by phone from Zagreb, Croatia is Anto Nobilo.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. May I ask the Defence if there is any problem with the detention of Mr. Blaskic that you want to raise at this stage.

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYMAN
utterances.text: Your Honour, this is Mr. Hayman. There are no issues per se, but there have been some changes in the health status of General Blastic, and I would ask you to ask him directly on that so the Court is informed of his physical condition.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. Let me turn to Mr. Blaskic. THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Your Honour, yet again, I was diagnosed with anemia, and now I will undergo therapy that will go on for about a month. And after that, I will be subjected to further examinations and treatment. However, today, I can follow the proceedings, and I feel able to do that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you, Mr. Blaskic. I'm sorry that your health conditions are not good again. I hope this will just be transitional, and that you will be fine soon. So my best wishes for that. If there is any problem, I'm happy you can follow the hearing today. But if there is any problem, you will tell me. THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Certainly. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Well, let's come to the status of this appeal which is approaching his -- its final stage. I want to tell the parties that the Appeals Chamber has now finalised the analysis of the additional evidence submitted by the appellant and of the rebuttal evidence proffered by the Prosecution. I can say that a decision concerning the admission of the evidence concerning all the status of the evidence will be issued shortly. When I say "shortly," it means within this week. So very shortly. And that will indicate all the evidence that has been admitted and what has not been admitted by the Appeals Chamber. At the same time, or maybe one day later, an order, a scheduling order, will be issued by the Appeals Chamber that will set out a time schedule and will concern maybe some organisational aspects for the subsequent course of the appeal with a view to coming to its final consideration. This is what I can tell the parties at this moment. Is there any comment on that by the Prosecution, or any observation?

utterances.speaker: MR. FARRELL
utterances.text: No, none, except for to say thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Farrell. Mr. Hayman, do you have any question to raise -- or any comment to make or any question to raise at this moment?

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYMAN
utterances.text: None, Your Honour. We will await the Chamber's order.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Of course the parties know that there are a number of pending motions still that concern mainly access to documents with respect to different appeals. I can't say anything about these motions. As the parties know, they require a decision of the full Bench. And as the Presiding Pre-Appeal Judge in this case, I can only inform you that all the submissions are being carefully considered. And that we'll come to decisions as soon as possible. Well, I don't have anything else to tell the parties at this stage. May I again ask the parties if they have any other issue to raise. Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. FARRELL
utterances.text: There are no other issues on behalf of the Prosecution. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Farrell. Mr. Hayman?

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYMAN
utterances.text: None, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Hayman. Then such being the case, this Status Conference stands adjourned.
